eventDetail.scope: Intl. Conf. on Universal Village (UV), now in its 14th year, is established as the premier venue for exemplifying a desired future society that pursues human-nature harmony through the wise use of technology. UV concept signifies that we should follow the law of the universe, protect the environment/eco-system, understand humans' needs in-depth, and innovate new lifestyles, thus providing sustainable happiness for humanity. The conference will feature sessions: technical sessions; exhibitions; keynote speeches; panel discussions; City/Student/Art Forum; Competition;  UV2026 calls for collective efforts from world-renowned experts across multi-disciplinary fields to collaborate beyond traditional field boundaries. IEEE UV2026 features the theme of “Human-Centered AI Transformation for Future Empowerment: Explainable & Human-Intelligible Understanding, Intent-Aware Reasoning & Accountable Decision-Making, Human-Authorized AI Action, and Human-Supervised Reflective Learning.”
